purpose: Show that fixed-rank syndrome classifications cannot grow into a universal linear compression theorem. On every odd wheel, the attainable sign-syndrome set is the entire nonzero syndrome space. Therefore every proper linear quotient has a false zero: exact zero reflection requires retaining the full cycle-rank dimension, which grows unboundedly along the family.

odd_wheel.graph: W_n has an odd rim cycle v_0...v_{n-1}v_0, n>=3 odd, and a hub h adjacent to every rim vertex.
odd_wheel.edges: Orient spoke p_i from h to v_i and rim edge r_i from v_i to v_{i+1} (indices mod n).
odd_wheel.noncolourable: A proper 3-colouring would give the hub one colour and force the odd rim cycle to use only the remaining two colours, impossible. Thus W_n is not 3-colourable.

triangle_cycle_basis.basis_row: For each i let q_i be the triangle flow h->v_i->v_{i+1}->h: coefficient +1 on spoke p_i, +1 on rim r_i, and -1 on spoke p_{i+1}.
triangle_cycle_basis.independence: Each q_i is the only basis row using rim edge r_i, so q_0,...,q_{n-1} are independent. There are n of them, equal to beta, hence they form a full cycle-space basis Q.
triangle_cycle_basis.syndrome_equation: For a sign vector with spoke signs p_i in {+1,-1} and rim signs r_i in {+1,-1}, y_i=(Q s)_i=p_i+r_i-p_{i+1} in GF(3).

transition_lemma.solve_rim: Given target y and chosen spoke signs, r_i=y_i-p_i+p_{i+1}. It is a legal sign iff r_i!=0.

rules.y_i=0: p_{i+1} must equal -p_i; a flip is forced.
rules.y_i=+1: loops are allowed and the flip +1 -> -1 is allowed; only -1 -> +1 is forbidden.
rules.y_i=-1: loops are allowed and the flip -1 -> +1 is allowed; only +1 -> -1 is forbidden.

main_theorem.name: ODD_WHEEL_SIGN_SYNDROME_IMAGE_IS_ALL_NONZERO_VECTORS
main_theorem.statement: For odd n, {Q s : s in {+1,-1}^{2n}} = GF(3)^n minus {0}.
zero_absent: For y=0 every transition rule forces p_{i+1}=-p_i.
Going around an odd number n of forced flips changes the sign, so cyclic closure p_n=p_0 is impossible.
Hence no sign vector has Qs=0, agreeing with non-3-colourability.
every_nonzero_attainable: Take any y!=0 and choose an index j with y_j!=0. Regard the j-th transition as the final closing step.

For every i!=j, choose a loop p_{i+1}=p_i when y_i!=0 and the forced flip p_{i+1}=-p_i when y_i=0. Thus after traversing all other edges, p_j equals p_{j+1} when the number of zero y_i among i!=j is even, and equals -p_{j+1} when it is odd.
In the even case use the loop allowed by y_j!=0.
In the odd case the final step must flip. If y_j=+1 choose the orientation +1 -> -1; if y_j=-1 choose -1 -> +1. The initial spoke sign can always be chosen to realize the required orientation.
All transitions are legal, so the computed r_i are nonzero signs and Qs=y.

no_linear_compression_corollary.statement: Let H:GF(3)^n -> GF(3)^k be linear. If ker(H) is nonzero, then the projected zero-test H Qs=0 has a false positive on W_n.
proof: Choose any nonzero y in ker(H).
By the main theorem y=Qs for some edge-sign vector s.
Then HQs=Hy=0 although Qs=y!=0. Since W_n has no true zero syndrome, this is a false positive.
no_linear_compression_corollary.rank_requirement: Every zero-reflecting linear syndrome map on W_n must be injective, hence have rank at least n=beta. There is no nontrivial linear dimension reduction at all.
no_linear_compression_corollary.unbounded_family: As odd n grows, the required exact linear syndrome dimension grows linearly with the graph size. Constant-rank or o(beta)-rank zero-reflecting linear certificates cannot cover this explicit family.

relation_to_v6_0_v6_2.K4: W_3 is K4, so v6.0 is the first member of the same full-nonzero-syndrome phenomenon.
relation_to_v6_0_v6_2.rank4_frontier: v6.1-v6.2 remain valid classifications of small rank-four certificates, but the odd-wheel theorem proves that increasing fixed rank cannot eventually capture every non-3-colourable graph by linear syndrome quotienting.
relation_to_v6_0_v6_2.critical_problem: For W_n, S*(Q)=GF(3)^n-{0}. The largest linear subspace disjoint from S*(Q) is {0}; the v5.6 Critical-Problem safe-kernel dimension is exactly zero.

positive: Provides an explicit infinite replay family whose full attainable syndrome set is known in closed form.
Explains why K4's rank-three certificate does not generalize to a bounded-rank linear hash hierarchy.
Any future graphic solver must use graph structure, nonlinear state, or a contraction that changes the instance rather than merely linearly projecting its cycle syndrome.
killed: Conjecture that every non-3-colourable simple graph admits a zero-reflecting linear syndrome projection of some universal constant rank.
Conjecture that repeated low-rank classification up through rank 4,5,... can terminate at a fixed rank covering all hard instances.
Any proper linear quotient of the odd-wheel cycle syndrome, regardless of how formula-dependent the quotient is chosen.
not_killed: Polynomial recognition/contraction of odd wheels themselves; they are structurally easy obstructions.
Nonlinear/interlacement/critical-subgraph contractions that reduce the graph before syndrome testing.
Variable-rank methods that remain polynomial without enumerating 3^beta states and prove exactness by non-linear structure.

next_target.name: E8_GRAPHIC_CRITICAL_SUBGRAPH_CONTRACTION_BEYOND_LINEAR_SYNDROME_V6_4
next_target.directive: Stop searching for universal proper linear syndrome quotients. Use the exact low-rank results only as local certificates. Seek a polynomial graph contraction/minimax rule on 4-critical or Hamiltonian degree-four cores that strictly reduces the graph while preserving 3-colourability and witness reconstruction. Mandatory controls include odd wheels, Moser spindle, the Hamiltonian fixed-C4 hard source, and K4. Nonlinear state is allowed only with a proved polynomial bound.
